rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for showing something to someone.

example.english: I’ve finished the report and want to display it to everyone.
example.traditional: 我整好咗份報告，想畀人睇吓。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zing2 hou2 zo2 fan6 bou3 gou3 soeng2 bei2 jan4 tai2 haa5

rows.note: Use this for publicly presenting or exhibiting an object, work, or information.

example.english: The museum will display a collection of precious artifacts.
example.traditional: 博物館會展示一批珍貴文物。
example.jyutping: bok3 mat6 gun2 wui5 zin2 si6 jat1 pai1 zan1 gwai3 man4 mat6

rows.note: Use this when displaying how to do something so that others can learn or copy it.

example.english: The coach will display the proper way to use this machine.
example.traditional: 教練示範點樣用呢部機。
example.jyutping: gaau3 lin6 si6 faan6 dim2 joeng2 jung6 ni1 bou6 gei1

rows.note: Use this when a person or thing displays a quality, feeling, ability, or behavior, often with 出.

example.english: We display great determination in the competition.
example.traditional: 我哋喺比賽入面表現出好強嘅鬥志。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai2 bei2 coi3 jap6 min6 biu2 jin6 ceot1 hou2 koeng4 ge3 dau3 zi3

rows.note: Use this as the ordinary noun for an electronic screen or monitor.

example.english: The display is broken, so I can't see anything.
example.traditional: 個顯示屏壞咗，乜都睇唔到。
example.jyutping: go3 hin2 si6 ping4 waai6 zo2 mat1 dou1 tai2 m4 dou2

rows.note: Use this for a show or spectacle put on for an audience.

example.jyutping: gam1 maan5 ge3 biu2 jin2 hou2 zing1 coi2

rows.note: Use this for a visual presentation or exhibit, including information arranged for people to see or touch.

example.english: There is an interactive display in the museum for people to touch.
example.traditional: 博物館入面有個互動展示，畀人摸吓。
example.jyutping: bok3 mat6 gun2 jap6 min6 jau5 go3 wu6 dung6 zin2 si6 bei2 jan4 mo1 haa5

rows.note: Use this for a shop display stand, rack, or other fixture used to present goods for sale.

example.english: This display holds the new sneakers.
example.traditional: 呢個展示架擺住啲新款波鞋。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zin2 si6 gaa2 baai2 zyu6 di1 san1 fun2 bo1 haai4
